decisions.0: 主责逐条全文读98完整方法+14字段/静态初始化，1158行3块。旧UnlockedMorphs和FavoriteIdentities字符串→typed EntityID/Variant与真实击杀获得、GUI消费及ServerPlayer.copyFrom一条独立玩家形态资格链1，不按variant/平台拆分。旧新解锁集合union由HashSet type+variant去重，新invalidVariant未走from(type,int)校验，坏Identifier缺局部catch，unknown registry跳过无原始payload保留。真实Clone忽略alive且复制abilityCooldown/remainingHostilityTime（tick递减、ability/monster目标实际消费，确为临时）和LivingEntity共享引用，漏identityType，不重建derived能力；不能借鉴为全玩家NBT复制。favoritesV2 compound写却STRING列表读，与CurrentIdentity嵌套IdentityType位置错配是具体静态契约风险未运行；respawnRETURN两mixin处理原参数而非返回新player，客户端cache不能替代server真值。Swap C2S未复核unlock，UI筛选不作服务端权限证明。IdentityType provider只深读Sheep默认白色不外推其余6种。getter/support/sync桥0额外信用。

scope: 98 supplied full methods plus14 declarations read in3 context chunks. Prevariant unlocks/favorites, kill/GUI consumers and real server copyFrom share one durable player identity owner. Timers/sync/cache support zero credit. Static only, no original save or production operation.
